text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "Swiss presidents only pay presidential visits, but on occasion are received on state visits by their foreign hosts.", "gist": "Swiss presidents typically make presidential visits, but sometimes receive state visits from foreign leaders."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "The concept of the state visit presents no problems when foreign heads of state come to Switzerland, because they are received by all seven members of the Federal Council.", "gist": "State visits by foreign heads of state to Switzerland are straightforward, as they are hosted by all seven Federal Council members."}, {"type": "number", "quote": "seven", "gist": "The number of Federal Council members who receive foreign heads of state on state visits."}, {"type": "date", "quote": "15.01.2025", "gist": "The date of the last modification of the text."}]}
